faq.a: Financial literacy means having the knowledge and skills to make smart decisions about your money, like understanding how to save, invest, borrow, and manage debt.

faq.q: How does the RBI regulate digital lending?
faq.a: The RBI has issued detailed guidelines for digital lending, requiring regulated entities (banks and NBFCs) and their digital lending partners to follow rules on interest rates, fees, data privacy, and grievance redressal.

faq.q: What should I do before taking a digital loan?
faq.a: Always check if the lender is regulated by the RBI, read all terms and conditions carefully, understand the interest rate and fees, and ensure you can comfortably repay the loan on time.

faq.q: Are all instant loan apps safe?
faq.a: No, not all instant loan apps are safe. It's crucial to verify if the app is associated with an RBI-regulated bank or NBFC. Beware of apps that promise very quick loans with no checks, as they might have hidden charges or unfair practices.

faq.q: Where can I learn more about financial literacy?
faq.a: The RBI itself has initiatives and resources on its website to promote financial literacy. Many reputable financial institutions and government bodies also offer free educational content.
